body:
feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says a medicinal odor came from the sprayer trial; the driver grew dizzy before the shelter message aired.

The children asked why the same place had two different names on the two papers. I told them to hold on to both until we knew.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.
title: coat pocket note — at tuesday dawn
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a medicinal odor while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
